title: MIF Container Manifest (mif-package.json)
description: Manifest for a lossless topic export/import unit between two research-harness-template instances (ADR-0017, research-harness-template#194/#275). Modeled on datapackage.json's resources[] array, extended with mandatory per-resource+manifest-level digests, ontology-pack bindings, an export-scope descriptor, a sourceInstance tag, and an explicit boundaryReferences[] mechanism for excluded subset-export cross-references. research-harness-template-local; independent of the org-wide MIF Container Profile (modeled-information-format/MIF#77) per ADR-0017's Context section.

profile.description: The container manifest's own declared format version (AD-... unrecognized-schema-version fail-closed, feature-spec AC9). A reader that does not recognize this value MUST fail closed with a named error rather than attempt best-effort parsing -- never silently accept an unknown profile.

sourceInstance.description: Origin/reconciliation tag (Story #324): identifies the corpus instance this container was exported from, separate from any individual finding's own W3C-PROV provenance.

namespace.description: Stable identifier for the exporting corpus instance (e.g. a clone or org label).

corpusUrl.description: Optional resolvable URL of the exporting corpus instance.

topic.description: The reports/<topic> slug this container was exported from.

selector.description: The subset selector used to build this export (required in practice for type=subset; null for full/incremental).

ontologyBindings.description: Ontology packs (id + version) the contained resources are typed against (Story #310), reusing the harness's existing pack extends mechanism (ADR-0012) rather than inventing a second one. Import (Story #318) rejects on a destination version mismatch.

resources.description: Packaged units (Story #309). MAY be empty (a zero-finding topic export is valid, not an error) -- manifestDigest is still required and defined over the empty set.

mifType.description: Discriminator for the kind of MIF concept this resource packages -- a container packages more than one kind of thing, unlike a plain Data Package resource.

path.description: The resource's file path within the container, relative to the manifest.

ontologyType.description: The resolved ontology entity_type for this resource (findings only); null for ontology-map/concordance resources.

digest.description: Mandatory per-resource content digest (Story #312) -- never opt-in, correcting Data Package's opt-in MD5-default hash.

boundaryReferences.description: Explicit boundary markers (Story #315) for a subset/incremental export's relationships[] or ontology-map.json edges whose target is genuinely excluded from this bundle -- never a silent drop. Closure takes precedence over marking (ADR-0017 AD-4): a target reachable via dependency closure is included directly instead of appearing here.

manifestDigest.description: Manifest-level digest (Story #312) computed over the sorted list of resource digests -- defined even for an empty resources[] array, mirroring OCI's self-verifying content-addressed manifest and npm's SRI-enforced install.
